$schema-note: Raw color values for the warm-dark 'Clay' theme (PLAN-rev2 §4.1). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — src/design/tokens.ts and evals/checks/contrast.mjs both read this file. Every entry in `pairs` is a foreground/background combination the UI actually renders text or icons in; contrast.mjs enforces each pair's `minRatio` (4.5 = WCAG AA body text, 3.0 = WCAG AA large text / icons). Accents (xpGold/gemTeal/streakFlame/success) are used as large numerals and glyphs, so they declare 3.0; text tokens declare 4.5. Non-text decorative shades (clayPressed, border, muted-as-divider) are not listed as pairs because they carry no text or essential-boundary contrast requirement.
